messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on the beach, raises one hand to touch her ponytail, places the other hand on her hip, and slowly turns from profile to face away from the camera.","camera":"A static medium-to-full shot at eye level, with the subject framed against the sea and sky.","clothing":"She wears a bright pink long-sleeved collared top, a matching pink pleated skirt, dark tights, and black platform boots.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled back into a high ponytail with loose strands at the face.","identity":"A slim young woman with light skin, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"A sunny beach with wet sand, calm blue water, a clear sky, and a few wooden posts standing in the shallow water."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a city rooftop with buildings and a tower to a sunny beach with calm water, wet sand, rocks, and wooden posts, matching the reference environment. The woman's pink outfit, blonde ponytail, pose, and slow turn from profile to back view remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the urban rooftop background with the beach setting from the reference image while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression was fully preserved is difficult to judge due to the stronger backlighting and profile angle.
unexpected_changes: The person appears more backlit and silhouetted in the output, with facial and body details less visible than in the source.
The ground changed from tiled rooftop to wet sand and stone slabs, as expected from the scene replacement but affecting the overall look.
The subject's apparent scale and framing are slightly tighter/lower in some frames, though the overall camera movement remains similar.
